name: turd_ball
title: Turd Ball Alchemy + New Ingredients
description: Reworks hard_ball into turd_ball using two new growable ingredients (mud_clump at temp[198], stink_moss at temp[196]).

scene.description: Boot into Raptors room with Turd Ball learned/equipped and 5 of each new ingredient.

transforms.content:
call_global 0x36
write_word_at signed STATS_PTR_BOY + 15, 200
write_word_at boy + 42, 200
write_temp_word temp[198], 5
write_temp_word temp[196], 5
set_flag HARD_BALL, 1
write_word_at 0x0AD2, 0xFF22
write_word_at 0x0AD4, 0xFFFF
write_word_at 0x0AD6, 0xFFFF
write_word_at 0x0AD8, 0xFFFF
write_byte_at 0x0ADA, 0xFF
spawn raptor_purple, 0, 27, 39
unfreeze_boy_and_dog
end
